shots.description: The single continuous shot keeps the framing, camera behaviour and timing of <Video 1> with no cut: a 16:9 medium close-up, camera essentially static with a very slight drift, the pale backdrop of <Subject 3> filling the frame behind them. <Subject 1> stands leaning slightly forward with both gloved arms cradling <Subject 2> against their chest, the dog's head at the center of the frame, its upright ears clear against the pale background and its dark eyes open; the cool diffused light lays a soft highlight along the coat shoulder and falls off gently across the dog's fur. <Subject 1> holds their gaze into the lens, then shifts their eyes down from the camera onto the dog and begins to lower their head, chin dropping slowly, a soft leather-and-wool rustle sounding as the arms settle and the head descends. The dog stays calm and does not struggle, ears staying up and body settling deeper into the cradle of the arms. The descent continues until the person's nose comes to rest against the dog's forehead; on contact the dog's narrows and closes fully and its head tilts slightly into the person's face, with the dog's quiet breathing steady against the chest. The camera keeps drifting very slightly without reframing, and the pose holds motionless through the final frame, the nose against the dog's forehead and the dog's eyes closed.
